name: Bearer-token documentation prose and a short non-credential token must not warn
notes: TODOS #53 FP guard, reproducing the 2026-07 registry sweep's 164-FP corpus through generic-bearer-token-disclosure specifically. 'Bearer token'/'Bearer credential' phrasing has no digit and is under the 20-char floor; an all-letter token fails the digit requirement even past 20 chars.

content.text: Use this or the BIGHUB Bearer token. Provide a Bearer credential (not a Bearer key) for the Cortex REST API. All-letter session ids like Bearer abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGH are just placeholders.
